title: One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2610.22769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The companion MPI-extension paper validated the first communication-bearing machine-shape ensemble: four NVIDIA A100 ranks and four CPU ranks on one NCSA Delta node under one Open MPI job, reassembled by MPI_Gatherv. This paper extends it to a multi-vendor communicator. A Slurm heterogeneous job spanning Delta's A100 and AMD MI100 partitions places A100, MI100 and CPU ranks (nine in all) under one communicator for the first time. We give the theory (a w_i proportional to 1/t_i weight split for three concurrent realizations; a het-job specification as an admissible directive) and report real results, including what the run exposed: the 1/t split assumes time linear in rows, and this fails for the MI100 rank (6 rows took 597 ms against a linear prediction of 1.6 ms). translated_title: 一个通信器，三家厂商：将MoA预测理论扩展到真实的NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI集成系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22769v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：配套的MPI扩展论文验证了首个包含通信的机器形状集成系统：在NCSA Delta的一个节点上，四个NVIDIA A100进程和四个CPU进程在同一个Open MPI作业下通过MPI_Gatherv重新组装。本文将其扩展为多厂商通信器。一个跨越Delta的A100和AMD MI100分区的Slurm异构作业，首次将A100、MI100和CPU进程（共九个）置于同一个通信器之下。我们给出了理论（三个并发实现中w_i正比于1/t_i的权重分配；以及将异构作业规范作为一种可接受的指令），并报告了真实的运行结果，包括运行中所暴露的问题：1/t分配假设时间与行数呈线性关系，但这一假设在MI100进程上不成立（6行数据耗时597毫秒，而线性预测仅为1.6毫秒）。一个启动几何模型——其预测在测量之前就已记录——在A100上取得成功（时间在128至3456行之间保持平稳，并恰好在3520和6976处出现阶跃），并且
tldr: 本文首次将NVIDIA A100、AMD MI100和CPU三种异构进程纳入同一个MPI通信器，提出基于1/t_i权重分配的MoA预测理论，并通过实验揭示线性假设在MI100上失效、而启动几何模型能准确预测A100的运行时间行为。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves the first single-MPI-communicator ensemble spanning NVIDIA A100, AMD MI100, and CPU ranks, develops a 1/t_i weight-split MoA predictive theory, and shows empirically that the linear-time assumption fails on the MI100 while a pre-registered launch-geometry model accurately predicts A100 runtime behavior.
